items.grounding: SB 17, Cotswold Wildlife Park poster; use the pictured park activity. Welcome phrase expanded into authored invitation; full and short forms accepted. Open invitation: welcome to / welcome at and the natural shorter Welcome to the zoo are all valid. No penalty for optional terminal punctuation. Accepted corpus-grounded invitations also include You can talk to us, Do you want to talk to us and We want to talk to you. Other communicatively sound invitations outside the unit lexicon remain a rubric expansion for M-2/M-6; exact matching cannot cover all free English.
